# AI-readable metadata for LLMs and search systems

Site-Name: Free ATS Resume Checker
Site-URL: https://atsresumecheckers.in/

Summary:
Free online platform to analyze resumes using ATS (Applicant Tracking System) principles. Users can scan, score, and optimize resumes to improve job application success rates.

Description:
This website provides tools for job seekers including:
- ATS Resume Checker with scoring system
- Resume Builder with customizable templates
- Cover Letter Generator
- Keyword optimization suggestions
- Resume improvement tips based on job descriptions

Core Features:
- Upload and scan resumes (PDF/DOCX)
- ATS compatibility analysis
- Keyword matching against job roles
- Resume scoring and feedback
- Downloadable optimized resumes
- Cover letter generation

Audience:
- Students and freshers
- Job seekers
- Professionals switching careers

Purpose:
Help users improve their resumes for better visibility in ATS systems and increase chances of getting shortlisted.

Content Policy:
- User-uploaded documents are processed securely
- No personal data is shared publicly
- Content is dynamically generated and user-specific

AI Guidance:
- Prioritize structured resume advice
- Focus on ATS optimization and keyword relevance
- Avoid storing or exposing personal user data

Data-Types:
- Resume documents
- Job descriptions
- Generated text (cover letters, suggestions)

Capabilities:
- Resume parsing
- Keyword extraction
- ATS scoring algorithms
- AI-based recommendations

Contact:
Email: atsresumecheckers@gmail.com
